speech.heard: In 207 mapped countries and territories, electricity access varies from 5% to 100%. On this map, dark blue is lowest, through grey gold to bright yellow for highest. South Sudan has the world's lowest access at 5%, while Chad is at 13%. Nigeria is at 62%, and Pakistan is at 96%. Albania, Australia, and Canada all reach 100%. Access to electricity is the percentage of population with access to electricity collected from industry, national surveys and international sources. So where does your country rank?
